description: Defines the interface for a reftable iterator, including operations for seeking, iterating, and destroying iterator instances. It declares the reftable_iterator structure, function prototypes for navigation and resource management, and references external structures.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_seek_ref
methods.description: Positions the iterator at the record with the specified name for subsequent iteration.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_next_ref
methods.description: Retrieves the next reference record and advances the iterator.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_seek_log_at
methods.description: Positions the iterator at a specific log record identified by name and update index.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_seek_log
methods.description: Positions the iterator at the newest log record with the given name.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_next_log
methods.description: Retrieves the next log record and advances the iterator.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_destroy
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the iterator.
